main_body: Round leafy tree canopy (about 28 rows tall) on a short brown trunk with a small grass patch at the base
top_band: Organic canopy: lighter greens (#68a95e, #4b8e52) at rows 11-16 and 23-30 inside the mass, with no flat horizontal top band. The canopy is a rounded volume shaded with clumps.
evidence: This is an organic tree, a rounded canopy volume with a trunk below it. It has no rectangular top, front-edge line or opening, so the contract is judged by volume. The canopy reads as a rounded mass lit from above, with lighter clumps on the upper and lower lobes and a dark underside shadow above the trunk. The trunk is short, with a grass patch at its base. No side face is drawn, and it is not an elevation, plan or rim-only piece. It reads as a plausible 3/4 tree.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 12 distinct colours and a median of 6 colours per tile, against 108-109 median and 427-567 distinct colours in the references. The canopy has about 5 green steps in large blocky clumps with no leaf-level dots, no per-leaf highlights and no grain. The trunk is a plain 2-tone brown stripe, and the grass patch is a few flat blocks. The outline is a dark teal-green tint (#142a2c), not neutral, and 0% of dark edge pixels are neutral. Even so, it is far flatter and thinner than the references, which carry dense leaf clumps, branches and bark detail.
